caption: The drawing depicts two wooden dolls, each seen from behind and slightly to the side, positioned side by side. Both dolls are dressed in detailed clothing consisting of pinkish, long, flowing dresses with blue and green sashes and bows. The fabric is shown with fine cross-hatching to indicate shadow and folds, and the sashes wrap around the bodice, tying at the back and shoulders. The dolls have unfinished oval faces without features and straw-like hair bunched and sticking out from the tops of their heads. The left doll is seated on a reddish-brown, textured stool, and the right doll is similarly posed but at a different angle, revealing more of the right side of its dress. The arms and legs of both dolls are articulated and roughly shaped. The background is plain and uncolored, leaving the focus on the two figures. The drawing utilizes a muted color palette dominated by earth tones, soft pink, and blue. The artist's signature, "Federico Malta," is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Doll
